slides.texte_overlay:
Boring money rules every
man should know by 25
Wait 48 hours before any big purchase. If you still want it two days later, buy it. Most impulse buys disappear from your mind long before then.
Know your fixed costs by heart. Rent, phone, transport, subscriptions. Knowing exactly what leaves your account every month is the base of every good money decision.
Never lend money you can't afford to lose. To friends or family, give only what you'd be okay never seeing again. It protects both your money and the relationship.
Automate the boring stuff. Bills, savings, rent on fixed dates. Automatic payments mean you never pay late fees and never forget to save a single month.
Before: money confused and stressed me. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and the curiosity to learn how money really works.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: money confused and stressed me. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now I'm curious enough to learn how money works.

slides.texte_overlay: Avoid lifestyle creep. When your salary goes up, raise your savings first, then your spending. Living like you earn less is the quiet secret to calm.
Spend on things that last. Good shoes, a solid coat, quality tools. Paying a bit more for things that last years costs less than replacing cheap ones.
